en-US.author: BinaryMark
en-US.description: The most comprehensive and precise Biorhythms app to explore biorhythms with charts, tables, reports, compatibility diagrams, critical day lists. Track 15 built-in rhythms, custom cycles, activities, lunar phases for yourself, family, and friends.
en-US.longDescription:
Unlock the full power of biorhythms with the most comprehensive and precise Biorhythms app!
• Track every biorhythm cycle：from the 15 built-in like Primary, I-Ching, Secondary, Intuitive Patterns to user-defined custom cycles whether period- or combination- based rhythms.
• Visualize biorhythms like never before with 11 fully customizable and interactive views：Graph, Table, Calendar, Timeline, Compatibility, Report, and others.
• Take time planning to the next level and let biorhythms inform your decisions by defining activities that trigger when your biorhythms hit the right thresholds, so that the app will automatically show the best times for them.
• Apply biorhythms effortlessly：stay ready for bad days and seize the opportunities of good ones with all-in-one Threats and Opportunities View.
• Note your biorhythms coincidences, all the times when 2 or more cycles intersect with ease!
• Explore your compatibility across various areas with loved ones, relatives, and friends using a detailed, sortable Compatibility View, and compare multiple biorhythms side by side.
• Make personalized reports in a few clicks with charts, tips, and visuals ready for sharing online or printing!
• Get started quickly. There’s no learning curve thanks to the Office-like Ribbon UI, interactive tutorial, and detailed tips.
• You can copy, save, and print from any biorhythms view, explore a wide range of options, and see your biorhythms instantly with clear icons and trend indicators. Export your biorhythms in Excel, PDF, JPG, WEBP, iCalendar, and many other formats.
• A state-of-the-art navigation system ties it all together, plus many more conveniences like optional Astrology, Numerology, and Celebrity Database modules that further enhance the already impressive product’s feature set. If you are ready to let biorhythms guide your life, then grab this powerful Biorhythms App now and master your days, relationships, and decisions exactly when they matter most!
